from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the provided collection, identified by title and its outbound citations to other collection papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cites_collection_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the provided collection that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
